description: Loss function ablation: WikiText-2 (in-distribution) and C4 (OOD) PPL at 50% sparsity, global top-k allocation, LLaMA-3.1-8B
key_findings: Forward KL dominates both in-distribution and OOD, confirming mode-covering is optimal for sparsity prediction
Reverse KL gap is stable across domains (WikiText +8.6%, C4 +8.3%), suggesting consistent but suboptimal patterns
JSD OOD gap amplifies dramatically (WikiText +6.4% -> C4 +42.2%), indicating mixed objective overfits to training distribution
All learned predictors dramatically outperform training-free TEAL baseline
